title: 第12章 失踪
slug: 皇家县令我每日躺着收税
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

这什么脑回路？怎么突然就想到杀人去了？

张宁没好气道：“本县是县令，是这荒山县的父母官，不是土匪，你想杀人给谁看？”

“这，这不是大人给小人的买命钱？”胡阿三一怔，却仍有些不敢置信，又不想让自己，替他杀人，那他为什么给自己这么多钱？

张宁都气笑了，“你的命就值这几个臭钱？”

“不瞒大人，这些钱够买小人的命两个来回了。”胡阿三却是无比认真道。

闻言，张宁有些沉默。

也是，对于这些可怜到能吃土、啃树皮的穷苦百姓，这一袋子的铜钱，确实是笔天文数字了。

“这些银子，是本县从钱家，为你娘子先讨回来的一点小补偿。”张宁看向胡阿三，“胡阿三，本县已调查清楚了。你是良民，不是刁民。”

胡阿三顿时眼睛一红，鼻子发酸，嘴唇颤抖，“大，大人……”

“啪！”

话未说完，他就猛地给了自己一耳光。

张宁皱眉，“你这是何意？”

“大人，小人不是东西啊，您为了小人伸张正义，小人却以为你和那姓钱的畜生相互勾结，还，还暗骂您是狗官，我我我，我真不是人啊。”

凝香也不敢置信地看着张宁。

方才殿下在外面多管闲事，救下胡阿三，她就已经很惊讶了。

万万没想到，殿下竟然会为了胡阿三这个只见过一面的人，亲自去钱家要钱。

这这这……

无法无天，连宰相孙女裙子都敢掀，和眼前这个殿下，到底哪个才是真正的殿下？

“那你倒没骂错。”张宁浑不在意地笑笑，“本县跟那姓钱的，现在确实称兄道弟了。”

胡阿三想也不想道：“大人肯定有大人的苦衷。”

张宁：“……”

你小子还真是够见钱眼开的。

“大，大人，这么多钱都是给小人的？”胡阿三又低头看了眼布袋，感觉自己简直像是在做梦一样。

不，就是梦里也没有过这么多钱啊。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

What kind of brain circuit is this?Why did you suddenly think of killing someone?

Zhang Ning said angrily: "This county is the county magistrate, the parent official of this Barren Mountain County, not a bandit. Who do you want to kill to show me?"

"This, isn't this money that adults give to villains to buy their lives?" Hu Asan was stunned, but still a little unbelievable, and he didn't want to let himself kill people for him, so why did he give himself so much money?

Zhang Ning laughed angrily, "Is your life worth these stinky coins?"

"To be honest, sir, this money is enough to buy the villain's life for two rounds." Hu Asan said extremely seriously.

Hearing this, Zhang Ning was a little silent.

Yes, for these poor people who are so pitiful that they can eat soil and chew tree bark, this bag of copper coins is indeed an astronomical figure.

"This money is a small compensation that the county has collected from the Qian family for your wife." Zhang Ning looked at Hu Asan and said, "Hu Asan, the county has investigated clearly. You are a good citizen, not a unruly citizen."

Hu Asan's eyes suddenly turned red, his nose felt sore, and his lips trembled, "Sir, sir..."

"Crack!"

Before he finished speaking, he slapped himself fiercely.

Zhang Ning frowned, "What do you mean?"

"Sir, the villain is not a thing. You seek justice for the villain, but the villain thinks that you and that beast surnamed Qian are colluding with each other. Furthermore, he secretly curses you as a dog official. Me, me, me, I am really not a human being."

Ningxiang also looked at Zhang Ning in disbelief.

She was already surprised when His Highness saved Hu Asan just now because he was meddling in other people's business outside.

He never expected that His Highness would go to Qian's house to ask for money in person for Hu Asan, a person he had only met once.

This, this, this...

Who is the real Highness, the lawless one who even dares to lift the prime minister's granddaughter's skirt? Or the His Highness in front of me?

"Then you are right." Zhang Ninghun smiled nonchalantly, "This county and the man named Qian are indeed brothers now."

Hu Asan said without thinking: "My lord, I must have your own difficulties."

Zhang Ning: "..."

You kid is really greedy for money.

"Sir, sir, all this money is for villains?" Hu Asan looked down at the bag again, feeling as if he was in a dream.

No, I have never had so much money even in my dreams.
